# Coverage: UI operation to API endpoint

Every operation available in the OpsDesk web UI, and the endpoint(s) that perform it. All paths are relative to `/api/v1`. A test fails if an endpoint listed here does not exist or if a documented endpoint is missing from this table.

## UI operations

| Area | UI operation | Endpoint(s) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Workspaces | Load the dashboard | `GET /dashboard` (`getDashboard`) | Paginated alternatives: listWorkspaces, listGroups, listBookmarks. |
| Workspaces | List / open a workspace | `GET /workspaces` (`listWorkspaces`)<br>`GET /workspaces/{id}` (`getWorkspace`) |  |
| Workspaces | Create a workspace | `POST /workspaces` (`createWorkspace`) |  |
| Workspaces | Rename a workspace / change its icon | `PATCH /workspaces/{id}` (`updateWorkspace`) |  |
| Workspaces | Reorder workspaces (move up/down) | `POST /workspaces/{id}/move` (`moveWorkspace`) |  |
| Workspaces | Delete a workspace (move or delete its groups) | `DELETE /workspaces/{id}` (`deleteWorkspace`) |  |
| Groups | List / read groups | `GET /groups` (`listGroups`)<br>`GET /groups/{id}` (`getGroup`) |  |
| Groups | Create a group | `POST /workspaces/{id}/groups` (`createGroup`) |  |
| Groups | Rename a group; collapse / expand it | `PATCH /groups/{id}` (`updateGroup`) |  |
| Groups | Reorder a group (drag or menu) | `POST /groups/{id}/move` (`moveGroup`) |  |
| Groups | Move a group to another workspace | `POST /groups/{id}/move` (`moveGroup`) |  |
| Groups | Delete a group (move or delete its bookmarks) | `DELETE /groups/{id}` (`deleteGroup`) |  |
| Bookmarks | Add a bookmark (optionally into a new group) | `POST /groups/{id}/bookmarks` (`createBookmark`)<br>`POST /workspaces/{id}/groups` (`createGroup`) |  |
| Bookmarks | View details, note and URL; copy URL | `GET /bookmarks/{id}` (`getBookmark`) | Copying to the clipboard is client-side; the API returns the URL. |
| Bookmarks | Edit a bookmark | `PATCH /bookmarks/{id}` (`updateBookmark`) |  |
| Bookmarks | Pin / unpin (favorite / unfavorite) | `PATCH /bookmarks/{id}` (`updateBookmark`) | Pin and favorite are the same field: `favorite`. |
| Bookmarks | Duplicate a bookmark | `POST /bookmarks/{id}/duplicate` (`duplicateBookmark`) |  |
| Bookmarks | Move a bookmark to another group or workspace | `POST /bookmarks/{id}/move` (`moveBookmark`) |  |
| Bookmarks | Reorder bookmarks (drag, earlier/later) | `POST /bookmarks/{id}/move` (`moveBookmark`) |  |
| Bookmarks | Delete a bookmark | `DELETE /bookmarks/{id}` (`deleteBookmark`) |  |
| Recent | Open a bookmark (record the launch) | `POST /bookmarks/{id}/opened` (`recordBookmarkOpened`) | The browser opens the link; the API only records it. |
| Recent | Show "Recently opened" | `GET /recent` (`listRecent`) |  |
| Search | Search this workspace / all workspaces | `GET /bookmarks` (`listBookmarks`) |  |
| Search | Filter by environment, tags, favorites; show "Pinned" | `GET /bookmarks` (`listBookmarks`)<br>`GET /tags` (`listTags`)<br>`GET /environments` (`listEnvironments`) |  |
| Search | Command palette (jump to a bookmark or workspace) | `GET /bookmarks` (`listBookmarks`)<br>`GET /workspaces` (`listWorkspaces`) |  |
| Settings | Edit the dashboard title | `PATCH /settings` (`updateSettings`)<br>`GET /settings` (`getSettings`) |  |
| Settings | First run: sample data or empty dashboard | `POST /setup` (`completeSetup`) |  |
| Settings | Remove sample data | `POST /sample-data/remove` (`removeSampleData`) |  |
| Settings | Show version, About, active database engine | `GET /version` (`getVersion`)<br>`GET /capabilities` (`getCapabilities`)<br>`GET /session` (`getSession`) |  |
| Import / export | Export JSON | `GET /export` (`exportDashboard`) |  |
| Import / export | Preview an import (JSON or browser HTML) | `POST /import/preview` (`previewImport`) |  |
| Import / export | Apply an import: merge or replace | `POST /import/apply` (`applyImport`) |  |
| Backups | List backups and their metadata | `GET /backups` (`listBackups`)<br>`GET /backups/{name}` (`getBackup`) |  |
| Backups | Create a backup | `POST /backups` (`createBackup`) |  |
| Backups | Download a backup | `GET /backups/{name}/download` (`downloadBackup`) |  |
| Backups | Restore a backup | `POST /backups/{name}/restore` (`restoreBackup`) |  |
| Backups | Delete a backup | `DELETE /backups/{name}` (`deleteBackup`) |  |
| System | Health | `GET /health` (`getHealth`) |  |

## API-only operations (no UI button)

| Operation | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| Clear the recently-opened history | `DELETE /recent` (`clearRecent`) |
| Machine-readable API contract | `GET /openapi.json` (`getOpenApiDocument`) |

## Not applicable to the HTTP API

| Browser/deployment behaviour | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Theme, layout density, sidebar state, last workspace | Stored in the browser (localStorage), not on the server. |
| Workspace selection screen, routing, Back/Forward | Client-side navigation. |
| Drag and drop gesture | The result of the gesture is a move/reorder call (see moveBookmark, moveGroup). |
| Launching a URL in a new tab, copying to the clipboard | Performed by the client; the server must not launch browsers. Read the URL with getBookmark. |
| Documentation link | Static documentation served under /docs/. |
| Selecting the database engine, credentials, ports, data directory, API token, CORS origins | Deployment configuration: deliberately outside the writable API (read-only engine info via getCapabilities). |
